scope: Pin Golden Gate to Tahoe v0.82.18 with wallpaper-driven panel ink, unified native menu text and stable menu titles during focus changes.
approval: The maintainer approved the local Tahoe and Golden Gate menu comparison and requested publication.

checks.command: Verified the published Tahoe release archive against all 13 changed repository files, including the version and component ledger.
Ran the four immutable release archive gate cases and the verified fallback installation case.
Reviewed the Golden Gate menu and panel in KDE neon against the native macOS reference.

coverage_limits: Visual and frame checks used one KDE neon Wayland output. The first activation of an unknown menu waits for its exporter.
